raw_segments.text: Your Highness, lately sending into France, did claim some certain dukedoms, in the right
of your great predecessor, King Edward III.
In answer of which claim, the Prince our Master says that you savor too much of your youth,
and bids you be advised there's not in France that can be with a nimble, galliard one.
You cannot revel into dukedoms there.
He therefore sends you, meter for your spirit, this ton of treasure.
And in lieu of this, desires you let the dukedoms that you claim here know more of you.
